title: Gold Holds Firm Above $3,740 as University of Michigan Inflation Expectations Anchor Yields
summary: Spot Gold held steady near $3,741/oz as the revised UoM survey confirmed long-run inflation expectations holding at 4.3%. Institutional bullion desks noted resilient ETF demand.
aiRationale: Anchored inflation expectations prevent further surge in real yields, reinforcing support for spot gold near record highs.

title: Dow Jones Advances Led by Industrials as Consumer Sentiment Beats Preliminary Print
summary: The Dow Jones Industrial Average (US30) climbed higher in afternoon trade as the Revised UoM Consumer Sentiment rose to 51.7 versus 51.0 previous, driven by Caterpillar (CAT) and Boeing (BA).
aiRationale: Consumer sentiment upside beats expectations, bolstering revenue visibility for cyclical Dow industrials.

title: Treasury Yields Consolidate Near Weekly Highs as FOMC Minutes and Jobs Prints Echo Across Rates
summary: The benchmark 10-year Treasury yield fluctuated near 4.42% while the Dollar Index traded rangebound around 106.8. Gold and equity desks digest policy reaction functions.
aiRationale: Yield stabilization around 4.42% removes immediate discount rate shock, allowing equities to consolidate.

title: Central Bank Gold Reserves Surge as Sovereign Diversification Offsets Dollar Volatility
summary: Official sector bullion purchases remained brisk heading into year-end as global reserve managers continued diversification away from single-currency debt holdings.
aiRationale: Persistent structural physical demand by monetary authorities creates a reliable bid underneath gold.
